|errata_history=This is the original printing, represented by the matching printed face in the August 2025 release sheet. It is not the current version; the current text is [[My Sister Has It (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the PC card image of this version.
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image in the repository revision of 9 April 2025<ref name="ht-msh-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/e6f69d52659159101b647b96a00a4cd5939e189e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/mysisterhasit.gif mysisterhasit.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/e6f69d52659159101b647b96a00a4cd5939e189e e6f69d5] (9 April 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. Text: “During battle involving Rebel Leia, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited. OR Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, ▲ Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[My Sister Has It (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 9, file created 10 August 2025: “During battle involving Rebel Leia, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited. OR Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, ▲ Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[My Sister Has It]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[My Sister Has It]] (repository revision 9 April 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•My Sister Has It”; the printed face matches the image in artwork, wording and visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[My Sister Has It (Errata 2)]]): PC card image in the repository revision of 9 March 2026<ref name="ht-msh-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Light/large/mysisterhasit.gif mysisterhasit.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae 6f23e07] (9 March 2026).</ref>, marked “E1”. What changed from the previous image: PC Tweak Set errata (marked “E1”): the card changes from a Used Interrupt to a Used or Lost Interrupt: the first option (“During battle involving Rebel Leia, the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited.”) is removed, the other two become the USED text, and a LOST text is added (“If Leia in battle, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.”). Text: “USED: Subtract 1 from a just drawn Force Lightning or 'choke' destiny (unless targeting an Undercover spy). OR If a [Skywalker] Effect on table, ▲ Chief Chirpa's Hut or Guest Quarters. LOST: If Leia in battle, all immunity to attrition there is canceled.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
